name: Magic Powder
description: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Psychic type, or if the target is Terastallized.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Bounced back to the original user by Magic Coat or the Ability Magic Bounce.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
The move plays its animation when used on an ally.
Has no effect on Pokemon which are Grass-type, have the Ability Overcoat, or hold Safety Goggles.
